OverlayMode.doc: What the full-screen overlay surface currently shows.

anchor.doc: In DIPs, relative to the client area of the surface that sent it (overlay.open) or of the overlay (overlay.show).

data.doc: appMenu: { appId } of the active app (items call dock.hide / dock.quit with itemId = appId).

token.doc: Increments on every show; stale async results can be dropped.

overlay.show.doc: Sent to the overlay surface after the host has shown/positioned the overlay window.

overlay.hide.doc: Dismiss whatever is open (hotkey toggled, focus lost, another app activated).

overlay.open.doc: Any surface asks the host to open the overlay (e.g. menubar -> controlCenter popover). Anchor is translated to overlay coordinates.

overlay.close.doc: Overlay UI finished (Esc, backdrop click, item chosen). Host hides the window.
